[size=6]Installation instructions:
[/size]
1. All required mods are listed before download. However, DOUBLE CHECK when downloading the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361]Challenging Community Center Bundles[/url] mod, you ONLY drop the second folder into your mod folder, not the first!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LUdFCQo.png[/img]
2. Put the Read Me file on your desktop or somewhere else safe on your computer. SDS will not run if its inside.

3. Please drag and drop the "SDS HD Portraits" into Portraiture mod!


[b]NOTE: SVE[/b] and other Map altering mods are NOT compatible with SDS as it is a Brand New map. If you plan on using an old save file with the community center completed, NPC Lucas's cutscenes will not work as they take place in JojaMart.

[size=6]Gameplay Notes:[/size]

The intro cutscene mentions needing to save all the characters in two years. However there is nothing programmed into the game that forces you to do that yet, so don't panic, just have fun with your game!

This mod is in progress from the Chinese developers. Rewrites are planned, and there are some locations where NPCs aren't yet implemented. But many updates are planned to come out! During breaks between college work I will try to keep up!

There has been minimal bug testing so expect misspellings/grammatical errors/etc. There are 1000s of lines of code so please feel free to report these in the discord and I will try and fix them in future updates!

Theres a known bug that sometimes clicking on spouses won't bring up dialogue. I apologize and I promise to look into this issue more, but it appears to be an issue with the hard coding of NPCs.
